title: Why Do We Spend So Much Money Online? 💳☕ | Slow Spanish for Beginners (Subtitles in 28 Languages)

subtitles.en:
Hello everyone! Welcome to AB Slow Spanish
Cafe.
subtitles.zh:
大家好！歡迎來到 AB Slow Spanish
Cafe。

subtitles.en:
Hello! Today we are going to talk about money
and online shopping.
subtitles.zh: 你好！今天我們要聊聊金錢和線上購物。

subtitles.en:
Yes. Why is it so easy to spend money
nowadays?
subtitles.zh: 沒錯。為什麼現在花錢變得這麼容易呢？

subtitles.en: The sentences are short and very easy.
subtitles.zh: 這些句子很短，也非常簡單。

subtitles.en:
Turn on subtitles in your language, and let's
get started.
subtitles.zh: 開啟你語言的字幕，我們開始吧。

subtitles.en:
Mia, I have to confess something. Yesterday I
bought something I didn't need.
subtitles.zh: Mia，我必須坦白一件事。昨天我買了不需要的東西。

subtitles.en:
Oh Alex, that happens to all of us. What did
you buy this time?
subtitles.zh: 噢 Alex，我們都會這樣。這次你又買了什麼？

subtitles.en:
A device to make coffee, but I already have
two at home.
subtitles.zh: 一台咖啡機，但我家裡已經有兩台了。

subtitles.en:
Hahaha, I knew it. Phone apps make buying way
too easy.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈哈，我就知道。手機應用程式讓購物變得太簡單了。

subtitles.en:
It's true. Now the store is in your pocket
twenty-four hours.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯。現在商店就在你的口袋裡，二十四小時營業。

subtitles.en:
And we pay with a credit card or phone. We
don't see physical money.
subtitles.zh: 我們用信用卡或手機支付。我們看不到實體貨幣。

subtitles.en:
Since we don't see it, we don't feel the pain
of spending.
subtitles.zh: 因為看不到錢，我們就感覺不到花錢的痛苦。

subtitles.en:
What a great truth! Experts call this
'invisible money'.
subtitles.zh: 說得太對了！專家稱之為「隱形貨幣」。

subtitles.en:
At the end of the month, you look at your
bank account and get scared.
subtitles.zh: 到了月底，你看著銀行帳戶就會感到害怕。

subtitles.en:
Money disappears very fast. Do you have any
trick to save?
subtitles.zh: 錢消失得非常快。你有什麼存錢的秘訣嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes. The first rule is the forty-eight hours
rule.
subtitles.zh: 有。第一個規則是「四十八小時規則」。

subtitles.en: How does that rule work?
subtitles.zh: 那個規則怎麼運作？

subtitles.en:
If I see something I want, I wait two days
before paying.
subtitles.zh: 如果我看到想要的東西，我會等兩天再付款。

subtitles.en: And what happens after that time?
subtitles.zh: 那過後會發生什麼事？

subtitles.en:
Most of the time the emotion passes, and I no
longer want to buy it.
subtitles.zh: 大多數時候，那種衝動會消失，我就不想買了。

subtitles.en:
It's a brilliant trick! And what is the
second rule?
subtitles.zh: 這真是個絕妙的技巧！那第二個規則是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Save first, and spend later. Keep a part for
the future.
subtitles.zh: 先存錢，後花錢。為未來留下一部分。

subtitles.en:
Many people do the opposite: they spend
everything, and nothing is left.
subtitles.zh: 很多人做相反的事：他們花光所有錢，最後什麼都不剩。

subtitles.en: Exactly. Saving must be a priority.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯。存錢必須是優先事項。

subtitles.en:
I'm going to apply this rule for my next
coffee.
subtitles.zh: 我下次買咖啡時要應用這個規則。

subtitles.en: Hahaha, very well thought, Alex!
subtitles.zh: 哈哈哈，想得很好，Alex！

subtitles.en:
Now, let's practice five useful phrases from
today.
subtitles.zh: 現在，讓我們練習今天的五個實用短語。

subtitles.en: Listen carefully, and repeat after us.
subtitles.zh: 仔細聽，跟著我們重複。

subtitles.en: Phrase one: To spend money.
subtitles.zh: 第一個短語：花錢。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Gastar dinero.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Gastar dinero。

subtitles.en: Phrase two: To save money.
subtitles.zh: 第二個短語：存錢。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Ahorrar dinero.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Ahorrar dinero。

subtitles.en: Phrase three: Personal budget.
subtitles.zh: 第三個短語：個人預算。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Presupuesto personal.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Presupuesto personal。

subtitles.en: Phrase four: Credit card.
subtitles.zh: 第四個短語：信用卡。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Tarjeta de crédito.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Tarjeta de crédito。

subtitles.en: Phrase five: Bank account.
subtitles.zh: 第五個短語：銀行帳戶。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Cuenta bancaria.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Cuenta bancaria。

subtitles.en: Great job with the phrases!
subtitles.zh: 這些短語練習得很好！

subtitles.en:
Now, listen to the conversation again without
reading. Train your ear!
subtitles.zh: 現在，不看字幕再聽一次對話。訓練你的耳朵！

subtitles.zh: 在下方評論區寫下你的答案。

subtitles.zh: 訂閱 AB Slow Spanish Cafe 以學習更多簡單的西班牙語！

subtitles.zh: 下次見，好好管理你的錢！
